method: solid alpha > 127; head ratio by multi-scale template match of the head band against the median frame; best-shift silhouette IoU; phases from ground clearance and stride width; NEAR/FAR lead from the lightness of the two feet (FAR one shade darker); torso x from the trunk columns of the torso band; seams from forge_core.transition_mae (premultiplied RGBA)
notProven: Pose quality, anatomy, appeal and readability at game scale: look at frames-review.png and the game-size frames.
That the head band holds only the head: arms raised into it change the match.
NEAR/FAR leads in auto mode rely on the 'FAR limbs one shade darker' convention; declare the colours to be sure.
Phase labels come from feet clearance and stride width, not from the pose.

checks.note: head scale against the median frame (frame 0 template)
head match residual over the median: face or costume drift
pairs with best-shift silhouette IoU at or above the threshold and similar colours
needs --cycle run or walk and an even frame count of at least 4
needs --cycle run or walk and an even frame count of at least 4
range of the torso x in game px; scale_frames --root-lock torso-x removes it
ground line of each sheet row; scale_frames --row-baseline aligns them
largest frame-to-frame change over the median step; review these joins first

slicing.method: ownership (forge_core.ownership_slice, haze drop): solid components to the cell holding most of their pixels, soft pixels to the owner they reach through soft pixels; nominal cell origin plus one shared padding

alternation.verdict: mixed: some half-cycle pairs repeat the lead
